title: World religions in their own terms: a foundation
tagline: A one-stop start: what each major religion teaches, with neutral overviews, primary texts and the Church's own view.
whyItMatters: You cannot talk well with a neighbour whose faith you do not understand. This track builds that knowledge fairly before you take up the harder questions.

mindset.tip: Describe other religions as their members would. If a Muslim, Jew, Hindu or Buddhist would not recognise your description, it is not yet accurate (1 Peter 3:15-16).
Do not flatten differences. "All religions teach the same thing" is not what the religions themselves say.
Notice the real goods in each tradition, as the Church does (Nostra Aetate 2; CCC 843).
Use neutral sources for the facts and religious sources for the voice, and note which is which.
Remember the aim: understanding that leads to respect, friendship and an honest witness to Christ.
